summary.intent: Use the GSD manager to discuss, plan, and execute the final two phases (38: retire deprecated web services, 39: user-configurable vault parameters) of a milestone, while also fixing an upload progress bar flashing bug.
summary.outcome: Both phases fully discussed, planned, executed, and simplified. Phase 38 PR (#422) opened with review comments resolved. Upload fix PR (#420) created and merged. Phase 39 pushed and simplified, ready for PR.

repo: folder.service.ts (1,059 LOC) and bin.service.ts (971 LOC) were deprecated service files; SDK equivalents already existed in packages/sdk and packages/sdk-core
Established SDK migration pattern: hooks import SDK methods directly and pass store-extracted state as explicit params — see useSharedWriteOps.ts as canonical example
BYO-IPFS config pattern (ByoIpfsConfig in packages/core/src/vault/types.ts) is the proven pattern for storing user settings in encrypted vault metadata on IPFS
@cipherbox/crypto had a circular devDependency on @cipherbox/core only for vault-ipns.test.ts; fixed by replacing imports with hardcoded test vectors
CipherBoxClient.getContext() exists at client.ts:312 and is a trivial field accessor (returns this.ctx) — not worth caching
Settings page has 3 tabs (Linked Methods, Security, Storage); Phase 39 added a 4th Vault tab
Bin retention was previously a server-side env var (RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS); Phase 39 moves it to user-controlled vault metadata
addFileToFolder, addFilesToFolder, replaceFileInFolder had no SDK equivalent before Phase 38 — extracted to packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts
purgeExpired had no public SDK method before Phase 38 — added to CipherBoxClient and packages/sdk/src/bin/index.ts
versionCids is Array<{ cid: string; size: number }> not string[] — must extract .cid when passing to CID-based APIs

code.finding: Encrypting state forced width: 100% !important on progress fill bar; first real progress event snapped it to 0%, causing visible flash. Fixed by shimmer on track + opacity: 0 on fill during encryption.
FolderNode construction was duplicated across two branches in the same function — extracted shared buildNode() helper
Had 5 unused state fields (isLoading, isSaving, error) and 4 unused actions; VaultTab manages its own local state. All removed.
Identical 12-line delete-with-behavior block was copy-pasted for handleDelete and handleDeleteItems; extracted to deleteWithBehavior() helper
getMaxVersionsPerFile() was called twice per prune site (once for each .slice()); cached into local variable
purgeExpired was missing IPNS unenrollment for purged entries and was not validating retentionDays input
getDepth, isDescendantOf, calculateSubtreeDepth are pure sync utility functions suitable for direct unit testing

workflow: Background executor agents must run in isolated git worktrees to avoid fighting over the working tree with the main thread
GSD plan agents may commit on differently-named branches than expected (e.g. docs/phase-38-plan vs docs/phase-38-context), requiring manual cherry-pick or merge to consolidate
Background agents hit usage limits mid-session; work can be resumed by re-launching with context about what wave/plan was last completed
Phase 39 executor committed to the main worktree before worktree isolation was enforced, leaking uncommitted changes into the Phase 38 branch working tree
Cherry-pick of the upload CSS fix initially appeared to land on the wrong branch due to a background agent switching branches; the stash mechanism caused confusion about what was committed where
Simplify agents should receive the full git diff from the correct branch before being launched — launching from the wrong branch produces irrelevant findings

friction: Background agents committed on different branch names than expected (docs/phase-38-plan vs docs/phase-38-context), requiring a merge to consolidate artifacts
Phase 39 executor ran in the main worktree initially, polluting the Phase 38 branch working tree with Phase 39 changes — had to restore files before typecheck
Simplify agents were initially launched while on the wrong branch (docs/phase-39-context instead of docs/phase-38-context)
Cherry-pick of upload CSS fix was confusing due to stash state and background agent branch switching
Usage limits hit mid-session, causing both the Phase 39 executor and a simplify agent to terminate early and require relaunch
GSD dashboard init tool showed 'no_directory' after branch divergence because planning artifacts lived on different branches
open_items: Phase 39 PR not yet created — branch pushed and simplified, ready for PR
Tests for new SDK folder helper functions (addFileToFolder, addFilesToFolder, replaceFileInFolder) and purgeExpired were noted as valid but the async versions remain untested
Server-side RECYCLE_BIN_RETENTION_DAYS env var should be deprecated and removed from infrastructure config now that it's user-controlled
uint8ToBase64 duplication exists across multiple packages but was not addressed (pre-existing, not introduced by Phase 38)
3-second setTimeout in VaultTab lacks unmount cleanup — noted as negligible but technically a minor leak
